findings.title: 2026 actual return omits rental income and private-use addition for non-main property
findings.required_action: Model applicable rental/direct property income and 2026 private-use addition, or block current-law tax-adjusted non-main-property scenarios until complete inputs are available.

findings.title: Future/transition path taxes non-main real-estate appreciation as annual accrual instead of the proposal's real-estate-specific treatment
findings.required_action: Implement the current bill's real-estate-specific capital-gains/direct-return treatment or disable proposed/transition Box 3 for non-main-property scenarios.

findings.title: Enhanced NHG check does not independently cap the non-energy cost stack at EUR 470,000
findings.required_action: Separate official a-g non-energy costs from h energy measures; enforce a-g <= 470000 and a-h <= 498200.

findings.title: Manual transfer-tax mode implicitly falls through as a main residence for Box 1 / Box 3 routing
findings.required_action: Add an independent property-use/main-residence classification and stop using transfer-tax mode as the Box 1/Box 3 classifier.

findings.title: Exposed erfpacht and deductible purchase-financing costs are not passed into Box 1 deductible own-home costs
findings.required_action: Explicitly classify deductible financing costs and periodic erfpacht, then pass qualifying amounts into the annual Box 1 bridge, or block affected tax-adjusted comparisons.

findings.title: Exports and calculation evidence lack immutable exact source/build identity
findings.required_action: Inject GITHUB_SHA or another immutable build identity at deployment/build time and include it in exported calculation evidence.

findings.title: Development Playwright dependency reports an advisory and lockfile contains an extraneous absolute-path entry
findings.required_action: Regenerate the lockfile in a clean environment and upgrade/re-audit the development dependency before security-clean sign-off.

findings.title: Box 3 payment is modeled at calendar-year end rather than actual assessment/payment date
0.1 percentage-point break-even scan is a numerical search and cannot mathematically prove every arbitrarily close double crossing
findings.required_action: Describe as a numerical search; adaptive subdivision is optional later hardening.
